incidents.name: Mure Distribution signer-source bypass
incidents.notes: The Mure distribution contract validated the claim authorisation against a caller-influenced signer source rather than a fixed trusted signer, letting the attacker forge an approved distribution and drain the QUEST held for beneficiary 0x29b0a315924E05aC0c898a63D96daA33CfD1cAc7.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x365083717eFB17F3895290BA38f20F568C7A4D8a created 2024-03-28 by 0x80922fd8cdc39ad594c1dac15f36d0aaafe6d47f, unrelated to attack sender; single EIP-1967 Upgraded event at deployment; 4,848,683.803036 QUEST drained (~5.45 ETH)
